# Draft:King Kenneth

----
King Kenneth, of Earth & Heaven
a King whom claimed the throne by war, King Kenneth died in is reincarnation on Earth and found himself to have already been king, and the throne was waiting for him in death. His wife Barbara died a year after him, Kenneth and Barbara Wheatley, who died Queen of Heaven
Their children and grandchildren carried gifts and other things which were seen as an act of God or something known as a reward. “There comes a time in a Wheatley’s life” he was known as a gangster in his youth, one of the most known around, not to be messed with. This dates back to his previous reigns. He is KJV, the ultimate God with Jessica. King James wrote the bible KJV for Kenneth’s granddaughter Jessica to find as a sign later on to fulfil a prophecy to make the family known and their story live on.
The Hollywood fires were an act of this God/King.
